target: Declared replacement-average committed membership churn; maximize retained base-selected output count
information: Base pool and candidate reference scores available; candidate test scores accessible only by logged queries
query_unit: One cached candidate-item score entry; no measured model inference or monetary cost claim
candidate_family: All pool-member x candidate replacements with uniform weights
reference_priority: Candidate-specific ridge prediction of flip counts from base-pool geometry on reference items; ridge=1.0; choose smallest predicted total row cost, then candidate with greatest predicted upper-bound reduction; label-blind seeded ties
ridge_features: Intercept, seven normalized pool scores, consensus-minus-cutoff, pool score range, worst-case flip count / M
mask: Shared across all replacements; retain safe selected prefix under upper costs; commit nonselected structurally invariant decisions only
integer_budget: floor(2 * k * alpha * M * T); queried candidate reveals all M replacement flips for that item
quality: RewardBench native preferred-response labels used only in verifier; WMT quality unknown
reference_and_pool_cost: Report candidate reference score entries and pool reference/test score entries separately from candidate test inspection counts
prior_data_exposure: Existing matrices are development panels already inspected; replay hiding does not constitute a new untouched final validation set
theory: Deterministic risk and optimal-retention-gap certificates; exact offline median certificate characterization, without online query-optimality claim
stop_for_method_claim: No distinct acquisition improvement beyond strongest simple method, or only stock interval claims, precludes asserting a new superior acquisition algorithm
